author: Spoookeh
body:
Hello there,

Firstly I'd like to say that I have nothing against Zicuri nor his team 'Horizon' but he has a history of cheating in the past, especially on servers such as OCN. He was also fairly recently banned by badlion's GCheat, one of the best anti-cheats in the world (https://www.badlion.net/profile/user/Zicuri/punishments). 

The first clip I'll show you isn't on Avicus itself, but is a first person 1v1 he uploaded very recently (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4JOJEeGvghs / Watching in 0.25x speed is preferable too). At 1:25, despite having the knockback disadvantage, he is able to hit the player from a good 4 blocks away. Perhaps this is due to his ping but I'd like you to bare this in mind. 

The first video on Avicus is this wonderfully edited clip https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VI3J_I-9ODw. Again his first hit is around 4 blocks away, and the knockback he gives is insane. Yes yes I'll probably hear the usual "Avicus knockback is messed up" but this is different. The first 2 hits send purchase 2 blocks into the air each, following knockback of about 4 blocks horizontally. Zicuri manages to keep perfect aim and land all 3 possible hits despite this strange and unusual kb that you don't see in a normal fight. Perhaps aimbot but also a chance of reach/an autoclicker being used. This (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJns9369vpI&feature=youtu.be&t=33s) is the clip from first person POV. 0:33 shows that Seuth isn't able to land the hit, despite having perfect aim and a much better ping advantage (as far as I know Seuth's average is around 10-40 while Zicuri's is between 130 and 300).

Secondly is this clip, also recorded on Avicus. While the others can be countered fairly easily, to me this is just straight up blatant reach; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=35ZSJIpYF6k The blocks between the two players are around 4 diagonally but also at a different height. No stupid avicus or minecraft mechanics can explain this.

Lastly is another 1st person POV clip. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJns9369vpI&feature=youtu.be&t=53s If you slow this down to 0.25x speed again you can see he gets a very unusual first hit despite Seuth once again having perfect aim AND the ping advantage. The vertical kb is also coming into play again here; I'm not too sure what this could be but I only see it happening so frequently to people fighting Zicuri showing it isn't Avicus in general but actually the player himself.

Thanks for taking your time to read this, a fairly quick response would be nice too.

Also in the case that Zicuri is actually banned I'd hope you wouldn't send the evidence straight too him, revealing who reported the player which could cause some backlash. An alternative is to download the videos and make a compilation, thanks :)

replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
Hey Spooking,

The staff had a chat about this the other day, I believe the majority decided that this player isn't hacking.
Although Zicuri's first hit on this video is pretty suspicious, every other video on your report doesn't show any hacking of any sort.

The instances where Zicuri's in a 1v1 and the other player can't get any hits in, that's just Minecraft being Minecraft..I myself have been in many situations where I can't manage to get a hit in (in a 1v1)

The only thing that caught my attention was the one hit on the video I linked earlier, but everything else seems fine.
I won't punish based off one dodgy hit though.

As of now, this report will be denied. But I'm going to leave this open in case you wish to discuss further.

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
"Is pretty suspicious"

I'm sorry if I've just been oblivious to the fact that someone getting 5 block reach is considered normal, but that clip clearly shows someone using reach modifications and cheating on avicus. 

As for the other clips, while they might not be as clear, they are still very suspicious and therefore backup the solid evidence of the first clip you linked in your reply.

Also I'm tired of the same old excuses, "it's just minecraft being minecraft" and "avicus has weird hit detection and KB anyway". Broken mechanics don't result in 5 block reach which is clearly shown in the video. If someone can please explain to me how this  (https://youtu.be/35ZSJIpYF6k) clip does not show Zicuri hacking then I would happily accept this as denied.

Also I'm still wondering how Zicuri found out about this report in the first place :D.

replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
Zicuri found out about this report? 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=35ZSJIpYF6k is the only piece of evidence that seems odd, every other video looks fine and doesn't show anything that indicates hacking.

And even in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=35ZSJIpYF6k, Zicuri has the lower ground and sprinted when he hit you, so it's plausible that he could have made the hit..although it looks sketchy.

However, all of your other videos however, show nothing that "backs up" this one clip.

You have several videos showing nothing, and one video showing something that could be hacking maybe.

There's not enough solid evidence to warrant a ban. Which is why this report will be denied.

Everything else is highly debatable too.

With everything pointing to a "well, this could maybe prove something" opinion, it is not enough to validate a permanent ban.

I don't know what's difficult to understand..
